༄༅/ /chos skyong lcam sring gi bskang gso bzhugs/na mo ha ya gṛ wa ye/'dir chos skyong lcam sring gi bskang gso sngon ma de ngag 'don la kha skong dang kha

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos skyong lcam sring gi bskang gso bzhugs/

na mo ha ya gṛ wa ye/ 'dir chos skyong lcam sring gi bskang gso sngon ma de ngag 'don la kha skong dang khrugs bsdebs 'ga' re byed dgos pa snang ba rnams byas te go rim 'brel zhing 'don cha dang mthun par 'jug pa bde bar brjod na/ mchod gtor rnams phyag len bzhin du bshams te byin gyis brlabs la/ chos skyong 'khor bcas bskyed pa ni/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po dmar la dwangs pa rba klong gru gsum bsnol mar 'khrug pa'i dbus su zangs kyi ri gru bzhi pa'i steng du padma nyi ma rta ro mi ro brtsigs pa'i gdan la/ praṃ dang zangs gri las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin chen po sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i zangs kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dam nyams kyi srog rtsa gcod cing*/ g.yon mda' gzhu dang dgra bgegs kyi glo snying thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung g.yon na bse'u ru mtshon dmar po bsnams pa/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs nas ljags rnam par bskyod pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ smin ma dang ma ra dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'bar zhing dbu skra kham ser ltag par bcings pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la zangs kyi beg tse dang dar gyi ral gu dmar pos brgyan cing*/ zhabs la sag lham dmar po gsol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa'i gzugs can g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du maṃ las rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma sku mdog sngo nag gdong pa bse/ so dung*/ smin ma g.yu/ mi'-i ral ba la mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan cing*/ gser gyi rna rgyan 'phyang ba/

gcer mo spyan dang zhal bgrad cing*/ g.yas zangs kyi ral gri dgra la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon lcags kyi phur bu bgegs la 'debs pa/ dred mo me zan la zhon pa/ gtso bo'i g.yas su praṃ las las mkhan srog bdag dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mdung dmar 'phyar zhing g.yon btsan gyi zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon cing lce spyang smyon pa la zhon pa/ mtshan mo rgyu zhing dgra bgegs la 'o dod 'bod pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi shar du mi dmar khra ma/ lhor ro tsi mi dmar/ nub tu kro dhi mi dmar/ byang du srog bdag ko shang*/ shar lhor aṃ kri mi dmar/ lho nub tu ro kri mi dmar/ nub byang du haṃ shang mi dmar/ byang shar du srog bdag thal ba ste/ gri thogs brgyad dang bshan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas zangs kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon la la rgyu ma'i lag dogs byed pa/ la la glo snying mchin pa 'brad pa/ la la snying khrag klad pa bldag pa/ la la sha khrag sbar gyi 'debs pa/ la la rus pa rkang mar 'cha' ba/ la la pags pa dmar bshus byed pa/ la la sha gdan dmar po 'dings pa/ thams cad kyang dgra bo'i srog len cing*/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang ba glang gi ko ba rlon pa gyon pa/ gzhan yang btsan dmar stong*/ bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong*/ ma mo 'bum sde/ the'u rang stong la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar ma ru tse'i dur khrod brag dmar po mchog lding gi pho brang nas gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ /kye/ yul gcig mya ngam 'das pa bdun gyi pha rol na/ /mda' na khrag mtsho phu na zangs brag brtsegs/ /mi ro rta ro mang po gcal du bkram/ /mi khrag rta khrag du ma mtsho ru 'khyil/

khor yug zangs ri'i phreng bas kun nas bskor/ /bse mkhar smug po mchong gi ba gam can/ /thod pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas/ /chos skyong dregs pa lham sring gshegs su gsol/ /'khor tshogs bshan pa'i tshogs kyang gshegs su gsol/ /zhing bcu'i dam nyams dgra bo 'dul ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis las bcol bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*/ /rings pa'i tshul gyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /nag po'i phyogs dang gang la dmigs pa yi/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /rakmo pra ṇa ārma sa pa ri wā ra a karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ /padma ka ma la ye staṃ/ de nas 'dir phyag 'tshal ba'am yang na sngon du mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bsdu na oṃ rakmo pra ṇa nas arghaṃ sogs sngags tsam gyis 'bul zhing rgyas par na/ stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa'i bandhi nang*/ ra dmar khrag chang mtsho ltar 'khyil ba 'di/ /chos skyong lcam sring 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dgra bgeg ma lus tshar cod mdzod/ /oṃ rakmo pra ṇa ātma sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ pra ti tstsha ye swāhā/ thog tha de bzhin du dang*/ dbang po'i me tog ri ltar spungs pa 'di/ = /sha chen tshil chen dud sprin 'khrigs pa 'di/ = /zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar 'bar ba 'di/ = /gser zhun 'khyil 'dra mkhris pa'i dri chab 'di/ = dgra bgegs sha khrag spungs pa'i zhal zas 'di/ = /snyan brjid sil nyan rol mo'i sgra dbyangs 'di/ /chos skyong =/ bzhes= tshar gcod mdzod/ oṃ rakmo pra ṇa nas pā phyaṃ sogs spyar nas 'bul zhing*/ sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūṃ btags la nang mchod phul te/ hūṃ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /ma rungs gdul phyir drag po'i skur bstan nas/ /mthu stobs phun tshogs bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i/ /sgrol gying bshan pa dmar po la phyag 'tshal/

/bka' yi 'khor gnas ye shes srung ma'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i bde ster gsang ba'i yum/ /las byed bshan pa gtum po sde lnga dang*/ /ma mo the'u rang tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ /ces bstod/ pas 'dir gtor ma 'bul lam/ ma phul kyang chog pas/ yig brgya brjod de/ kyai/ rdo rje 'chang chen padma kā ra sogs/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma mchog gsum lha/ /yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung dang*/ /srog bdag dmar po 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol/ /sems nyid rang bzhin mkha' ltar rnam dag kyang*/ /glo bur nyon mongs sprin gyis g.yogs pa'i mthus/ /nongs par gang gyur bshags dang bshags yul dang*/ /bshags bya dmigs med ngang du dag par bgyi/ /ces bshags pa byas nas brkang rdzas mchod pa dang bcas pa sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyi brlabs te/ kyai/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung mthu rtsal can/ /srog bdag dmar po 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs tshogs/ /'byung zhing rgyas la thugs dam skongs gyur cig /ra dmar khrag chang mchod yon mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /dbang po lnga yi me tog ri ltar spungs/ /sha chen tshil chen dud pa sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar 'bar ba 'dis/ /gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring thugs dam bskang*/ /las mkhan srog bdag dmar po'i thugs dam bskang*/ gri thog bshan pa'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skongs gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob nyams chags sos gyur cig /mi mthun rkyen dang bar gcod bzlog pa dang*/ /mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /gser zhun 'khyil 'dra mkhris pa'i dri chab dang*/ /dgra bgeg sha khrag spungs pa'i zhal zas dang*/ /snyan brjid rol mo'i sgra yis stong gsum khyab/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i gser skyems dam pa 'dis=

/rno sdug rwa g.yo sha rgyas dal gyis 'gro /mdzes pa'i spu ldan 'tshams sprin phung po bzhin/ /'ja' tshon ltar bkra dar gyi rgyan cha can/ /spyan gzigs bse yi ra skyes kham pa 'di= /zhol g.yag kham pa rnams ni ngar 'jo byed/ /mdzes ldan rta mchog rnams ni glog bzhin 'gyu/ /dur bya srin bya'i gar gyis mkha' lam khyab/ /bse khrab dam nyams klad la lding ba 'dis/ = /sra zhing brtan pa rdo rje'i go khrab dang*/ /rno ngar mi bzad sna tshogs mtshon cha dang*/ /dur bya'i sgros brgyan dar dmar g.yo bas mdzes/ /dgra bgegs snying la thog ltar rgyug pa 'dis= /sha khrag gtor ma'i tshogs kyis sa bzhi gang*/ /phyi nang 'dod yon tshogs kyis bar snang gang*/ /rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyis nam mkha' gang*/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod sprin 'dis= /sgrol gying srog bdag dmar po 'khor bcas kyis/ /gnod byed dgra bgeg thams cad tshar chod la/ /yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam shing bzhin du/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ru phob/ /de nas chos sku yangs pa'i pho brang nas/ /zhes sogs bzlog pa spyir ltar byas nas mthun pa'i dngos grub ma brjod/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ chos skyong gi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bas las thams cad sgrub par gyur ces brjod dam yin yang rung ngo*/ /oṃ rakmo pra ṇa ātma kṣi ru pu ru ṣa lo hi ta sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa yab kyi sngags dang*/ oṃ rakmo ya ma tsitta dzwa la raṃ pra ti de wi hūṃ srog la ya ma dzaḥsarba sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad phaṭa/ ces yum gyi sngags ci mang bzlas pa'i mthar yig brgya brjod de gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ chos skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi spu gu can du gyur pas gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsams la/

oṃ rakmo pra ṇa ādma sa pa ri wā ra sarba bighnan sha truṃ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ slar yang mchod pa dang nang mchod phul nas/ kyai rgya gar yul gyi dgra lha/ ma ru tse'i gnas srung*/ li yul chos kyi srung ma/ ma hā de ba'i bka' nyan/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' sdod/ yab gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral ba can dang*/ yum srin mo khrag gi ral ba can gyi sras gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi beg tse can/ sring mo srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ 'khor srog gcod bshan pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs stod/ bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ rnal 'byor ba bdag gi sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen thams cad sol/ mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad drag po'i chad pas skad cig nyid la thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces bka' bsgo/ de nas/ kyai byang shar ma ru tsa yi dur khrod nas/ zhes sogs kyi spyi bstod 'di byed pa'am/ 'dir ma byas kyang rung bar snang zhing*/ bstod pa ni/ kyai/ sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /rta ro mi ro bsnol ba'i khri steng na/ /gtum chen dgra bgegs srog 'phrog bshan pa ni/ /padma rā ga'i mdog can khyod la bstod/ /bdud dpung tshar gcod 'bar ba'i zangs gri g.yas/ /g.yon pas mda' gzhu dgra bgegs glo snying dang*/ /lhab lhab ba dan g.yo ba'i mdung dmar 'dzin/ /dam nyams kun gyi srog 'phrog khyod la bstod/ /zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs shing rngams pa'i zhal/ /dus mtha'i me ltar spyan gsum sdang mig g.yo/ /dmar ser ral pa ltag pa'i phyogs su bcings/ /sgrol gying srog bdag dmar po khyod la bstod/ khyod kyi g.yon na lha mo gdong dmar ma/ /phyag g.yas zangs gri lcags kyi phur bu g.yon/

/srin mo'i gzugs can dred mo mi zan chibs/ /char sprin ltar sngo gcer mo khyod la bstod/ /g.yas na las mkhan chen po dbang gi mdog / bse yi khrab rmog gyon zhing mdung dmar g.yas/ /g.yon pas zhags pa 'debs shing lce spyang chibs/ /skye 'gro kun gyi srog len khyod la bstod/ /gzhan yang dpal mgon khyod kyi bka' 'khor na/ /srog gcod las byed bshan pa pun nu nu/ /btsan dmar bdud dang srin po nyer re re/ /the'u rang stong gis mtshon sna sna tshogs 'gyed/ /ma mo 'bum ni nad yams bu yug 'tshub/ /mi bsrun 'khor tshogs dang bcas khyed rnams kyis/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ khams gsum 'gro ba thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las thams cad bsgrubs/ /zhes dang*/ 'di'i mjug tu/ sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan po gtong*/ /da 'chol legs pa'i gsol 'debs rten du 'bul/ rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin gces par skyongs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi gnas lus longs spyod dang*/ /'khor dang yo byad bzhon pa la sogs pa/ /bcol lo bltas so srung ma mthu rtsal can/ /nyin gsum bya ra rgyang nas ma g.yel cig /mtshan gsum mel tshe drung nas ma g.yel cig /rtag tu sgrub pa'i stongs grogs ma g.yel cig /bla mas bcol ba'i phrin las ma g.yel cig /sdang ba'i dgra la mngon pa'i rtags ston la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /bla ma'i sku dgra bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang*/ /rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe/ /ma nyes log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /dpal mgon khyod kyis sgrol la bstan pa srungs/ /zhes sbyar na legs so/ /de nas bye brag gi bskul dod na/ /bhyoḥ rigs pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ /zhes sogs sam/ bsdu na/ kyai chos skyong dregs pa lcam sring 'khor bcas la/

/gus pas mchod bstod 'phrin las bcol ba'i mthus/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dgon nas sbyin bdag la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra 'gegs 'byung po dang*/ khyad par nor rdzas rku 'phrog byed pa rnams/ /drag po'i las kyis myur du tshar chod la/ /bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor bcas kun/ /g.yel med srung zhing skyob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ zhes pa dang*/ mthar bzod gsol dang rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang med na gshegs gsol bya'o// 7 //de nas tha 'og pa'i gtor 'bul bsdus pa ni/ hūṃ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par/ /gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /rang bzhin gnas nas tha 'og chos kyi rgyal/ /'khor bcas spyan drangs brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon lnga/ /rin chen bdun dang gling bzhi ri rab sogs/ /phyi nang mchod sprin dam rdzas gtor mar bcas/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas mnyes phyir 'bul/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan myur mgyogs rta nag steng*/ /rngams brjid drag shul dpa' ba'i rnam 'gyur can/ /rdo rje bum pa bzung nas 'gying tshul gyis/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs phye mar 'thag la bstod/ /mthu chen khyod la mchod bstod gsol btab bas/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'bral med rtag srung zhing*/ /'gal rkyen bar cad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub bar mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis 'ga' re la phan 'dod kyi bsam pas co ne'i dgon nyid du bsgrigs pa'o// //sarba maṅgalaṃ//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ chos skyong lcam sring gi bskang gso bzhugs/ - PAGE 276-- PAGE 277- -PAGE 268-
